role: Published parameter reference with literal source values; not an admitted local parameter configuration

paper.title: LegacyVegetation: Northern Hemisphere reconstruction of past plant cover and total tree cover from pollen archives of the last 14 kyr
paper.attribution: Schild et al. (2025), Tables A1 and B1; retain paper DOI and table URLs when reusing these attributed extractions.

source_originals.role: Table A1 original RPP values, SE per publisher caption
Table B1 synthesis, SD and fall speed per publisher caption

extraction.cell_values: Literal decoded OOXML strings; no numeric conversion, rounding, blank/dash substitution, taxon aliasing or duplicate-label collapse. Per-field original cell references retained.
extraction.unused_sheet: Worksheet is empty in each source workbook; no records discarded.

statistical_semantics.original_uncertainty: Table A1 labels original estimates SE.
statistical_semantics.synthesis_uncertainty: Table B1 labels synthesis uncertainty SD. These are literal source labels; no SE-to-SD conversion or between-study interpretation has been performed.
statistical_semantics.rpp_units: Relative pollen productivity, with Poaceae reference normalization described by the paper.
statistical_semantics.fall_speed_units: The captured workbook labels the field vg and does not state its unit. No unit conversion was performed; verify the model/unit convention before any parameter admission.
statistical_semantics.n_estimates: Literal published n; not asserted independent study/site/sample counts.
statistical_semantics.missing_values: Empty cells and en dash remain distinct source strings. Neither is zero.
statistical_semantics.dependency: Overlaps the 2020 compilation; these are not independent parameter realizations.

source_discrepancies.disposition: Both source rows retained for all four regions; no automatic unique-taxon profile.

source_discrepancies.issue: Article text and workbook coverage differ
source_discrepancies.disposition: Count definitions are unresolved. Workbook counts describe these exact bytes, not a correction to the article.

source_discrepancies.Europe: RPP/SD/n are en dash, fall speed is 0.032.
source_discrepancies.disposition: Hemispheric values do not silently fill missing European productivity.

use_scope.site_applicability: Requires source-study, taxonomic level, reference taxon, basin and regional applicability decisions.
use_scope.validation_role: Parameter reference only; reconstructed vegetation from the associated study is not independent measured ancient vegetation.
use_scope.negative_love_policy: Does not apply to missing parameter cells or source identifiers.
use_scope.article_metadata_exposure: Publisher abstract and parameter prose were read, including published aggregate reconstruction accuracy statements. No linked site-level vegetation output, pollen record or measured-reference dataset was opened; this is not an untouched confirmation cohort.
